subject: Unbranded giveaway pallet — customs hold & split-staging plan
messages:
From: Kelly Park <kelly@stellarpromos.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logistics@moscone.com
Date: 2027-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pallet #A72 — commercial invoice mismatch & customs hold

Hi Jasmine,

Quick heads up: the shipment for the unbranded giveaway crates (PO #RWI-523) hit a customs hold in Oakland. CB flagged that the commercial invoice declares 2,400 units but the packing list we uploaded shows 1,900 — appears to be a last-minute packing change at the factory. I attached the commercial-invoice.pdf and packing-list.csv for your review.

Customs is requesting corrected paperwork before release; the broker says clearance could be delayed 48–72 hours unless we provide an explanation and an updated invoice.

If Redwood wants us to split the shipment (release only 1,200 units to go direct to the venue and leave remainder on hold), we can coordinate re-routing and provide new AWBs, but there will be additional handling fees.

Options we see:
- Correct invoice and push full release (longer clearance timeline).
- Split release now (partial to Moscone, partial hold).
- Return to bonded warehouse (time-consuming, not ideal).

Please advise ASAP — the Moscone receiving window is tight and we have on-site personalization scheduled for Friday.

Thanks,
Kelly Park
Account Lead — Stellar Promotions Co.
Attachments: commercial-invoice.pdf, packing-list.csv
From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
To: Kelly Park <kelly@stellarpromos.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, logistics@moscone.com
Date: 2027-07-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pallet #A72 — commercial invoice mismatch & customs hold

Kelly — thanks for the flag. A few quick clarifying asks:

1) How did the discrepancy happen? Was this a packing change at the manufacturer or a documentation error at origin?
2) If we do a split release, can you confirm estimated handling fee and any additional customs brokerage costs?
3) Can Global Cleared Brokers accept a corrected commercial invoice and a cover letter that explains the variance, or will customs insist on physical repacking inspection?

Monica — looping you in to confirm whether we can accept a partial delivery to Moscone and continue personalization on the delivered crates. Ben, FYI — this impacts staging and final counts for the activation.

Jasmine Liu
Events PM — Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Kelly Park <kelly@stellarpromos.com>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logistics@moscone.com
Date: 2027-07-11T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pallet #A72 — commercial invoice mismatch & customs hold

Kelly — thanks. Confirming internal constraints: we must have at least 1,100 finished kits on-site by Friday 07/16 for personalization and VIP fulfillment. Anything fewer will force us to re-prioritize VIP lists.

If the factory actually shipped 2,400 units but docs show 1,900, that's fine — we prefer a corrected invoice that reflects the higher quantity and a short cover letter explaining the discrepancy. If the physical count is lower, we need a salvage plan and a prioritized pick list for which kits to produce first.

Please attach photos of pallet labels/manifest and a statement from the factory. If you can route the first 1,200 units to Moscone and leave the remainder at bonded storage on the same AWB (split-release), we'll accept that but need firm ETAs and fees.

Attachments requested from Stellar: photos of pallet labels, corrected invoice (final-artwork-v2.pdf referenced for kit contents), and an updated packing-list.

Monica Patel
Field Marketing Ops — Redwood Inference
From: cb@globalcleared.com
To: Kelly Park <kelly@stellarpromos.com>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logistics@moscone.com
Date: 2027-07-11T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pallet #A72 — clearance options & fees

Good afternoon — Global Cleared Brokers here.

We reviewed the paperwork. Customs will accept a corrected commercial invoice plus a factory statement explaining the variance. Physical inspection is probable but not guaranteed. If Stellar elects split-release, we can clear the portion bound for Moscone within 24–36 hours after receiving corrected docs and payment of the additional brokerage and handling fee.

Estimated incremental costs: brokerage $180, handling/warehouse release $255, expedited courier for corrected docs $65. For full-release post-correction expect a 36–72 hour review window; for split-release expect $500–$700 in additional fees total depending on number of pallets released now.

We attached proforma-duties.pdf. Please route payment instructions to our accounting contact when you confirm.

Regards,
Marcos Alvarez
Global Cleared Brokers
Attachments: proforma-duties.pdf
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Kelly Park <kelly@stellarpromos.com>, logistics@moscone.com
Date: 2027-07-12T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pallet #A72 — commercial invoice mismatch & customs hold

Team — decision time. We cannot risk entire activation; proceed with split-release as proposed.

Action items:
- Kelly / Stellar: arrange corrected commercial invoice (reflecting factory count if 2,400) and factory statement; provide pallet photos and updated packing list by EOD 7/12. Confirm exact incremental fees from Global Cleared.
- Global Cleared: upon receipt of corrected docs, prioritize clearance for the first 1,200 units and send AWB updates to Moscone receiving. We will route payment for the listed fees — Kelly, please send an invoice to accounting@redwoodinference.com with a 2-day payment request.
- Moscone Logistics: accept partial delivery on 7/14–7/15 window; Moscone team, confirm receiving dock and contact person for on-site personalization.
- Operations: Monica, please prepare prioritized VIP pick list and staging instructions. If the second tranche clears later than 7/16, we will convert remaining units to standard giveaways and adjust VIP fulfillments.

This keeps the activation on schedule and limits exposure. Jasmine — you own updates to the internal stakeholders; Ben

Ben Carter
Director, Event Ops — Redwood Inference
